title: Black Anger: It Will Always Be WEAPONIZED Against The Movement | And Somehow, It STILL Works
description:
In this powerful interview, I sit down with Ashley Jones Burns, LPC. , and Steve Parris, M.Ed., to discuss the sudden rise of divisive videos portraying Black men as being against Black women—a harmful and false narrative. This rhetoric is part of a larger strategy to weaponize Black anger and disrupt Black unity. Together, we explore how systemic racism and racial manipulation are used to fracture the Black community and undermine progress of the whole resistance movement. 

We also delve into the psychological effects of these tactics and how they connect to the GOP's broader agenda, Trump’s divisive politics, and the resistance against fascism. This conversation highlights the importance of Black empowerment, mental health, and unity to counter these efforts and drive community progress forward.

Through honest dialogue, we aim to shed light on the psychology of racism and emphasize the strength of Black voices in overcoming attempts to sow division. This is a must-watch for anyone invested in dismantling systemic oppression and fostering solidarity.

📢 Watch now, share your thoughts, and join the movement to fight back against these divisive tactics. Together, we can build a stronger future.
